1.0.18:
• Security update: the app now accepts connections only from this computer, locks a username for 15 minutes after 5 wrong passwords, and uses stronger password storage.
• Stricter checks on everything typed or uploaded, plus browser security headers.
• Admin-only settings are now protected, uploaded files are verified, and developer tools are disabled in the installed app.
• Security fixes to the components the app is built on.
1.0.17:
• Label printing now works on Windows: labels go straight to your label printer, which the app finds by itself.
• New Printer settings (account menu): choose the printer and label size, set the top margin, and print a test label.
• New 60 x 40 mm folder / box label with a large QR code, file number and optional box note.
• Print folder labels for many clients at once from the Compliance tab.
1.0.16:
• New look: a cleaner, more professional font throughout the app.
• Small back arrows on pop-ups and detail screens.
• Tidier top bar: Scan lookup moved under More, and the bar can be made compact.
• New My profile page (name, job title, phone). Activity log moved into the account menu.
1.0.15:
• The Onboarding tab is now Compliance: see which clients have KYC and PEP paperwork on file (on paper or in the app), where it is kept, and who is missing or due for a re-check. Mark many clients as on file at once.
• Each client now has a Client file checklist (KYC, PEP, ID copies, engagement letter).
• Scanning a folder label now also shows the client's paperwork and CPF / GST status.
• Small info icons now explain the more complex screens.
1.0.14:
• You now sign in each time you open the app (closing the app signs you out).
• New live clock on the sign-in page and in the dashboard header.
• Page buttons on the Register and Onboarding lists, like the Clients list.
1.0.13:
• New Onboarding tab: every client's KYC and PEP paperwork in one place, showing what's been filled in, signed and verified, and what's still waiting. Each client also has an "Onboarding" button.
• New PEP declaration form (Part 2, with source of wealth and funds): the customer fills it in on screen, and a PDF in your paper layout is filed with the client's documents.
• Sign on screen or by hand: for KYC and PEP forms the customer can choose to sign by hand instead. Staff print the form, the customer signs it, and the scan or photo is uploaded back and kept with the record as the signed copy.
• Print button on every form.
• Existing forms: already-signed KYC/PEP forms can be uploaded for a client (Onboarding > Existing forms on file) and are stored as they are.
• New CPF and GST tiles on the Dashboard with a live "action needed" tag when a filing is due within 5 days, plus a quick Yes/Not yet check-off per company.
• Redesigned document viewer: gallery by month, page thumbnails, zoom, details panel, and loading indicators across the app.
1.0.12:
• Digital KYC form: from a client's window press "KYC forms" and hand the screen to the customer. They fill in the personal particulars form and sign on screen, the ID number is checked as they type, and a PDF of the signed form is filed with the client's documents. Staff review the details against the real ID and mark the form as verified.
• Uploaded documents: from a client's window press "View uploaded documents" to see every file as a pile of cards with a preview of the first page. Click one to read it in a full viewer inside the app (zoom, next / previous), or download it. You can search and filter by type or category, and upload new files from the same screen. Each time a file is opened or downloaded it's recorded.
• New Filing Helper: open a client and press "Prepare filing" for a GST return or AGM / Annual Return. You get a checklist of the documents needed, what's already on file (and which shelf any paper copy is on), company details you can copy with one click, and one download of all the files.
• "Mark as filed" records the date and the portal reference, and updates the client's GST schedule or last AGM date for you.
• Optional GST registration number on client details.
• Admins can edit the document checklists.
1.0.11: • Maintenance release to confirm the new in-app update flow works end to end. No changes to your data or day-to-day features.
1.0.10:
• In-app updates: you'll now be asked before an update is installed, with a short summary of what changed.
• Import clients: fixed the file selection not responding, and the import now reads the "Clients" sheet even when it isn't the first sheet in the workbook.
• Clearer error messages when an import file can't be read.
